text:
alice: FYI: SI reported perf regressions on A100 marketplace images after partner rolled driver 536.XX -> observed 15-30% throughput drop and occasional OOMs. Can we decide pin vs hotfix? Need partner alignment and marketplace image note. cc @mei @carlos
raj: Can you paste repro logs? Is it model-specific or runtime-level?
mei: We saw it on A100-80GB with cuda12.2 + kernel 5.15. Logs show `cuMemAlloc` failures and increased page-faults. Not model specific (reported on Llama2 and Mixtral workloads). Sample log snippet:
```
[ 12.345678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 35, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12.345679] nvidia: loading driver 536.2
[ 12.345700] cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
```
sam: Repro on our side in canary. Command to check driver: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader` Also kernel taints show: `NVRM: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 35`
carlos: Marketplace images with pinned driver currently set to `>=535.86, <537.0`. Suggest immediate temporary pin to `535.86` and cut canary images for partners. We should notify partner channels and stop auto-updates.
alice: Propose: (1) bump marketplace pin to 535.86, (2) spin canary with 536.x rollback and perf tests, (3) partner asks for hotfix from vendor if regression persists. Timeline: today EOD for pin, canary tomorrow morning. Thoughts?
mei: Agree. I'll reach out to vendor partner and request hotfix ticket. Also will ask for kernel patch diff. @sam can you run throughput comparison script? `./bench/throughput.sh --seq 2048 --batch 4`
sam: On it. Running now. Will post numbers in #eng-runtime. If we see >10% regression we'll escalate. ETA 2h.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: `marketplace-image-pin-535.86` started by @carlos. Status: running.
carlos: I'll craft marketplace advisory draft for customers and partners. Short note: 'We are temporarily pinning NVIDIA driver to 535.86 on A100 images due to observed performance regressions with newer drivers. We will update as vendor provides a fix.' I'll share in #partners-comms.
alice: Thanks — please add rollback playbook steps and IF partner provides hotfix we need validation checklist: perf smoke, KV-cache sanity, memory pressure tests.
sam: Quick update: canary shows 18% drop on 536.2 vs 535.86 on Llama2-13B seq2seq test. Attaching raw numbers in eng-runtime thread.
mei: Vendor acknowledged and opened ticket NV-24017. They asked for logs; I've uploaded. Keeping this channel in the loop.
alice: :thumbsup: closing loop — pin in progress, canary running, partner engaged. We will schedule a short sync at 11:00 PT if we have escalation. If urgent ping me.
